text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Two at-grade elevators and a station exit building are being constructed at the Toronto Transit Commission's (TTC) Chester subway station as part of the TTC's Easier Access Program and Second Exit Program. The construction activities no longer require a portion of Arundel Avenue to operate as a two-way roadway and it is recommended that the traffic and parking regulations be returned to pre-construction regulations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated Arundel Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and a point 87 metres north as one-way for southbound traffic only. 2. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on both sides of Arundel Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and a point 87 metres north. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Arundel Avenue, between a point 66 metres north of Danforth Avenue and a point 87 metres north of Danforth Avenue. 4. Prohibited parking at all times, in effect from 16th day to the last day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive on the east side of Arundel Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and a point 66 metres north. 5. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one-hour, in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, first day to the 15th day of each month, from April 1 to November 30,…
